$comment: KForge launch of the token TESTCAT on testnet-10 (kforge.xyz, listed by api-test.kforge.xyz /v6/tokens), read on 2026-11-05 from the public node wss://boson-10.kaspa.red (getBlock / getBlocks with transactions; block bodies are kept about 30 hours): the token genesis (one output bound to the token covenant id: the whole supply, 1,000,000,000 base units, owned by the creator key, owner scheme 0) and the launch (the creator moves the whole supply to the curve covenant, owner scheme 4, in the curve genesis transaction, payload KFORGE6). Inputs carry their spent outputs (`entry`); lock time, gas and sequences are 0. `mainnet_sell` is a mainnet transaction of the token GUCCI (read through the public mainnet resolver): a holder sells back to the curve; its inputs reveal two token redeem scripts (no entries recorded). crates/kob-tests/tests/programs/program_kforgetoken7214.rs rebuilds the transactions (their ids), reproduces the token inputs with KOB's builder and runs the testnet-10 ones in the engine.
